verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say it offers role-based banking access for team members and financial advisors, lets admins define roles and set card spend limits, and supports multi-step approval rules. That covers role assignment for team members. Nothing shows permissions can be scoped by location or department, or how granular the role definitions are. A Trustpilot summary mentions minor permission issues, but that is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: permissions scoped by location or department, a documented list of role or permission granularity, independent hands-on corroboration.
